title: Define Flowly V1 product and engineering baseline
description:
USER CLARIFIED PRIMARY OPERATING MODEL 2026-10-09: Flowly V1 is AGENT-FIRST CLI-FIRST, HUMAN-MONITORING-FIRST. HUMAN uses local Web UI primarily to MONITOR tasks, progress, QA/Review results, evidence and history, with explicit fallback manual interventions. AGENT works operational flows via first-class local CLI, not by clicking Flowly UI through Computer Use. CLI is NOT optional secondary functionality. Both surfaces share exact same authoritative domain services, SQLite database, business rules, audit, workflows and QA/Done gates. No required Relay/ChatGPT/Agent runtime built into Flowly. CLI contract owned by FWL-0021 with FWL-0022 (Task/Review/Bug), FWL-0023 (Preview/Capture/QA), FWL-0024 (monitor UI). FINAL USER DECISION: Agent CLI may explicitly finalize Preview Approval and QA PASS/FAIL/WAIVED, Review and Done with the same gates and full actor/channel/evidence audit as user UI; no passive auto-approval. Preserve approved product scope and current 20 functional design cards.

FLOWLY V1 PRODUCT BASELINE LOCKED: Flowly ITSELF is a SINGLE-USER standalone LOCALHOST browser-based WEB APP, but it manages development projects whose TARGET UI PLATFORM can be Web, Desktop or Mobile. Two primary user-facing features: (1) five-lane Task Board and (2) editable interactive HTML/CSS/JS-based UI Preview with cross-platform postimplementation Visual QA. Fixed engineering stack: strict TypeScript, React + Vite, Node.js + Fastify, SQLite + Drizzle, Tailwind, Modular Monolith/Clean Architecture. No multiuser accounts, Owner/RBAC, permission delegation or Tauri/Electron/Rust APP shell. USER-APPROVED EXTERNAL QA (2026-10-09): ChatGPT Computer Use MAY inspect controlled Web/Desktop/Mobile target apps externally and submit Screenshot/QA evidence via OPTIONAL Local API/Relay, and MANUAL Upload is ALWAYS supported independently; both go through same comparison against frozen Approved Preview. Previous blanket 'no ChatGPT integration' restriction SUPERSEDED only for optional external evidence handoff. Do NOT introduce mandatory embedded ChatGPT/LLM/Agent/MCP runtime, cloud service or login; Flowly works without external connector. Local screenshot recorder with controlled browser remains a Web-target adapter only. Preserve two-feature scope and local persistence; do not implement before signoff.
reasoning:
Core local Flowly has OPTIONAL external Screenshot Local API only, separate from Manual Upload. USER-APPROVED 2026-10-09: one Flowly-generated Access Token per installation across external tools, loopback-only and validated before accepting image, never logged. Token persists across restarts with no expiry/auto-rotation; only explicit Regenerate+confirmation replaces, and successful replacement revokes old immediately without grace; cancel/failure leaves existing token. External tools reconfigure, local QA evidence/history and Task/Bug remain. Previous OPEN token lifetime/regeneration policy resolved. FWL-0017 owns detailed API auth. User-approved 2026-10-09 Settings UI: mask Token by default; explicit Reveal displays the existing current Token and Copy copies it, including after leaving Settings or restarting, WITHOUT Regenerate. Token never appears in logs/errors/QA. Only user-confirmed Regenerate rotates token. Multipart binary request encoding is approved; image limit is 25 MB; PNG JPEG WebP approved; user-approved sourceId self-declaration and optional Capture ID dedup policy are LOCKED under FWL-0017.
USER-APPROVED 2026-10-09 optional Local API Capture ID policy FWL-0017: after authentication, sender/source+Capture ID retries are idempotent (original receipt/evidence, no extra Screenshot/Inbox/Visual Compare); new IDs always represent fresh captures even if image identical, omitted IDs always new, same IDs from different sources independent. This is solely an optional integration behavior, not a mandatory requirement on core Manual Upload. Token remains one per installation, no auto expiry, Settings masked Reveal/Copy, user-confirmed Regenerate. Stable sourceId is self-declared by each sender together with captureId; Flowly requires NO sender registration. Omitted captureId => sourceId optional and EVERY authorized request new; sourceId is a dedup namespace, NOT authentication. Multipart binary, 25 MB max, PNG/JPEG/WebP-only and image-content validation are locked. Other formats and malformed files do not create evidence or alter QA.
USER APPROVED 2026-10-09: Flowly screenshots stored as ONE unmodified original for each distinct accepted capture, plus separate UI thumbnail; Visual Diff is generated on demand, not saved as a permanent file every time. Settings shows total image storage usage and permits only user-initiated manual cleanup (never automated). Existing QA/Bug attachment history and sourceId+captureId retry identity remain intact. USER RESOLVED 2026-10-09: manually cleanup only unreferenced Screenshot originals. Any QA PASS/FAIL or Bug reference, including from past Approved revision or archived Case, protects file from deletion; show reason and referring QA/Bug. Never auto-delete or mutate QA/Bug history and Task/Bug status. Mixed-batch cleanup is now USER LOCKED 2026-10-09: delete eligible selected originals and skip protected ones, showing actual success/skip counts and linked QA/Bug reasons while retaining all Task/QA/Bug histories. USER LOCKED 2026-10-09: after manually deleting eligible unreferenced original, keep old Receipt/sourceId+captureId as DELETED tombstone. Authenticated retry same ID pair returns Deleted without restoring file or creating Inbox/Compare, while a NEW captureId creates a new Screenshot. Tombstone must survive restart; protected QA/Bug files remain non-deletable. Deleted-entry UI now USER-APPROVED: hidden from ordinary Screenshot and Inbox lists, visible only in History when filtering Deleted, Receipt and deletion metadata only, NO original or thumbnail and NO Restore. No change to approved token, file type/size or QA rules.
Deleted Tombstone UI is metadata-only: no original or thumbnail image can be opened, and NO Restore operation exists. Deleted items appear only in History after selecting Deleted, not ordinary Screenshot List or Unassigned Inbox.
Flowly V1 final user choice 2026-10-09: original Task Done immutable as a workflow state, NO manual or automatic Reopen even for confirmed new defects. Post-Done findings use standalone linked Bug Task with own Board/Review/QA gates, preserving original completion, QA and review audit. Pre-Done embedded Bug behavior unaffected. This decision closes the last explicitly requested V1 product approval gate before final design review.
2026-10-09 material clarification overrides earlier UI-first assumption: operational user is Agent through local CLI; human majority monitors via Web UI. Product now requires complete CLI surfaces, reduced tool calls, discoverability and shared domain logic. Added FWL-0021 parent and 0022..0024 children (all design Backlog). Prior 20-card Final Design Review readiness must be reconsidered until CLI contract and now-resolved explicit Agent CLI / user UI approval authority are reviewed and signed off. No implementation authorized.
acceptanceCriteria:
- Flowly runs as single-user localhost Web app managing Web/Desktop/Mobile target UIs. Retain strict TS/React/Vite/Fastify/SQLite/Drizzle/Tailwind modular stack, Task Board and interactive UI Preview, no multi-user accounts/RBAC/login or mandatory embedded AI/Agent/MCP/cloud.
- Optional external Screenshot Local API remains bound to loopback only and uses exactly ONE shared Flowly-generated installation-wide Access Token for all external tools; validate before ingest/storage, no raw token in logs, metadata or API error output (FWL-0017).
- APPROVED TOKEN LIFECYCLE: same Access Token persists across restarts indefinitely without automatic expiration or rotation; user alone can click Regenerate and confirm to replace it; successful regeneration immediately revokes old Token with no two simultaneously valid tokens. Cancel/failed regeneration retains old token. External tools must adopt new Token.
- Regenerating token must not delete Screenshots/Unassigned Inbox, QA history or alter Task/Bug status. Unauthorized external evidence cannot enter Inbox; authorized screenshots follow validated Task/Screen association and user-only Visual QA verdict.
- Manual Screenshot Upload and local Task Board/Preview still work offline and do NOT require Relay/Computer Use nor external Local API Token. Web-controlled Browser Capture remains Web-target only; no mandatory connector.
- Settings masks the Access Token by default; Reveal and Copy are explicit user actions to view/copy the SAME current token at any later time without Regenerate or expiration. These controls never rotate or log secrets; user-confirmed Regenerate alone revokes old token.
- OPTIONAL Local API screenshot idempotency USER APPROVED: external sender provides stable SELF-DECLARED sourceId together with captureId (no Flowly registration). Same sourceId+captureId after successful Access Token validation reuses original evidence/receipt; different pair creates independent screenshot. Missing captureId => sourceId optional, always a new authorized capture; incomplete captureId without sourceId rejected. sourceId is not authentication and never bypasses shared Access Token.
- Independent Manual Screenshot Upload has no sourceId/captureId nor optional external API Token requirement.
- OPTIONAL localhost external multipart Screenshot API max RAW BINARY image file part 25 MB inclusive. Over-limit => clear HTTP 413 and NO persisted Screenshot, Unassigned Inbox, Visual Compare, QA PASS/FAIL/WAIVED, Task/Bug state, temp files or Capture ID reservation (FWL-0017). Do not apply this API-specific image size limit to independent Manual UI Upload without separate user decision.
Optional Local API accepts genuine PNG/JPEG/WebP image bytes only (<=25 MB). Validate decoded content not extension or claimed MIME; reject unsupported/corrupt with clear error and no screenshot, Inbox, Visual Compare, QA/Task/Bug mutation or Capture ID reservation. Independent Manual Upload unchanged.
- APPROVED screenshot storage across Manual Upload, Web local capture and optional external API: preserve ONE unmodified original image file per NEW accepted Screenshot, create separate derived UI thumbnail, compute Visual Diff ON DEMAND against frozen Approved Preview and do NOT store a permanent Diff file for every comparison. Existing external sourceId+captureId retry reuses original evidence, no duplicate storage.
- Display Screenshot STORAGE USAGE in Settings (including originals and derived assets). Cleanup of historical screenshots ONLY when explicitly initiated/selected by single user; NO automatic retention-age, Task-Done or storage-threshold cleanup of originals. USER-APPROVED: Cleanup may remove only explicitly selected originals with NO QA PASS/FAIL or Bug referencing them, including historical Approved revisions and Archived QA Cases. Block protected original deletion and display specific QA/Bug references. Never automatically clean or change QA/Bug history, Task/Bug status. USER LOCKED BULK CLEANUP: deleting a mixed selection must process originals independently, delete all still-eligible originals, skip those referenced by QA PASS/FAIL or any Bug, and show successful deleted and skipped-protected totals plus per-image QA/Bug blocker references and reasons. Do not cancel entire batch or change Task/QA/Bug history/status. CAPTURE TOMBSTONE APPROVED: after successful user Cleanup of unreferenced external Screenshot, preserve sourceId+captureId and original receipt/evidence ID as DELETED durable audit metadata; file and thumbnail removed. Authenticated retry same pair returns DELETED, never recreates image, Inbox/Compare or alters QA/Task/Bug; a NEW captureId is required for new Screenshot. Manual Upload unaffected. No automatic Cleanup or cleanup of QA/Bug-protected images.
- The original/thumbnail/diff/cleanup rules do not introduce cloud, Agent, external API Token dependence for Manual Upload or new roles.
- USER-APPROVED Deleted History UX: after successful eligible Screenshot Cleanup, remove Deleted Screenshot from default Screenshot List and Unassigned Inbox; keep original Receipt, sourceId, captureId, deletion time and Deleted status accessible in History with explicit Deleted filter. Deleted rows have NO openable original/thumbnail or Restore action. Missing optional IDs in Manual Upload shown unavailable, not invented. Cleanup never alters QA PASS/FAIL/WAIVED, Task/Bug statuses or QA/Bug audit.
- USER-APPROVED Web Recorder/Replay/Auto Capture session policy (FWL-0016): maintain Cookies and Local Storage in separate persistent controlled-browser profile PER PROJECT. Reuse across Record, Replay, Capture and Flowly restart; isolation by Project even if same localhost Web URL. Provide explicit Reset Session for current Project only; clear only its browser login storage, not other Project sessions or saved Screenshots/QA evidence/Recorder steps. Do not log/store secret Cookie/Session Token values in Logs or QA metadata; if server session expires, require new login. Applies to Web-only local recorder, not Manual Upload, native Desktop/Mobile or optional external API Token.
- FINAL USER DECISION: Done Task status is TERMINAL. User cannot Reopen/move Done Task into any other lane via UI or local API; Screenshot, Bug, human post-Done QA FAIL or any automation cannot change original Done state. Preserve previous completion/Review/QA history. Any newly found defect after Done => separate independent top-level Linked Bug Task in Backlog, its OWN workflow/Smart Review/QA and bidirectional link, not a child. No QA/Review inheritance or automatic verification from origin; FWL-0014 owns details.
- NEW V1 CORE ARCHITECTURE: AGENT uses FIRST-CLASS local Flowly CLI for every approved operational capability, including Task Board, Checklist/Subtasks, Preview draft/state, Review, Bugs, QA Case/evidence, Browser Capture/Replay and workflow transitions, with machine-first concise JSON and one-shot context; no UI click or Computer Use needed to operate Flowly. CLI and Web UI share one domain persistence/gates/validation/audit; no duplicate business logic.
- HUMAN mostly MONITORS via Web UI with current Board/agent progress, status, QA/Bug/Review blockers, Preview screenshots and audit. Keep existing manual fallback actions where approved. CLI operation independent of Web UI browser being open, no mandatory ChatGPT/MCP/Relay/cloud.
- V1 now has linked CLI+monitor design work FWL-0021..0024. FINAL USER-LOCKED 2026-10-09: explicit Agent CLI or user Web UI can Approve Preview, confirm QA PASS/FAIL/WAIVED, complete Review and request Done; exact same validation, immutable revisions, Required current QA, Review/tests/subtask gates and no Done Reopen. Record actor/channel/action/time/evidence/revision/prior and new states. Passive screenshot, compare, capture or retry NEVER grants approval, QA PASS/FAIL or Done.
verification:
Review Flowly itself as a single-user localhost browser application, with Task Board and HTML/CSS/JS UI Preview as core. Inspect 3 managed project examples with target platforms Web, Desktop and Mobile: all use same card QA evidence and frozen Approved Preview matching, without forcing target app into web. Test Manual Screenshot Upload with optional Computer Use/Relay disabled. Test optional external Local API/Relay evidence ingestion separately when configured. Check no unexpected RBAC, built-in AI/Agent runtime, cloud dependency, Tauri/Electron/Rust app shell; no implementation until user approval.
Verify optional Local API accepts 25 MB binary image part but rejects over 25 MB with explicit 413 and no persisted QA/Inbox/Task/Bug side effects; manual browser Screenshot Upload functions independently without Relay/API size policy.
Check default Screenshot and Unassigned Inbox exclude cleaned item; History Deleted filter finds original Receipt, sourceId/captureId (or absent fields), deleted timestamp and Deleted status. No image, thumbnail or Restore. Authenticated old-key external retry returns Deleted without creating image/Inbox/Compare after restart. Protected QA/Bug images cannot be cleaned. Design only.
Verify two Web target Projects using same URL do not share login; each retains own persisted Cookies/Local Storage after Flowly restart through Record/Replay/Capture. Reset Session only one Project, do not alter other browser profile or QA evidence/history. Ensure logs, error responses, Recorder steps and QA Metadata contain no raw Cookies/tokens. Expired login must fail capture safely/NEEDS EVIDENCE; manual upload unaffected.
AGENT-FIRST CROSS-SURFACE E2E: without opening Flowly Web UI, agent completes supported Task/Preview/Capture/QA/Review/Bug work via machine-readable CLI, one concise context call and stable output/IDs. Human opening Web UI sees same state, progress, evidence, history and blockers. Try forbidden Done reopen, invalid QA approval and duplicate evidence through CLI; validation must match UI domain. Check no interactive CLI prompt, no mandatory Relay/cloud, no tokens in CLI logs. Agent CLI explicitly authorized to issue Preview Approval, QA PASS/FAIL/WAIVED, Review and Done with the same domain gates/audit as user UI; passive screenshot and compare never decide.

title: Design five-lane Task Board workflow
description: FLOWLY V1 single-user local Task Board with EXACTLY FIVE lanes Backlog/To-do/In Progress/Ready for Review/Done. Independent Checklist/Subtasks; parent unfinished child normally blocks Done unless explicit Force Done with nonblank reason, preserving other Smart Review/tests gates. For UI Task with Approved Preview, QA Case matrix FWL-0020 auto-generates/syncs ONLY explicit full Screen+State+Viewport/window/device tuples: brand new Case Required default, editable Optional, matching across Approved revisions preserve ID/classification/history but need fresh QA, removed Archived, exact returning Archived Case Restored original. ALL active Required Cases for CURRENT approved revision need own explicit Agent CLI or human UI confirmed PASS or explicit individual current-revision CASE WAIVED; Optional nonblocking. Separate explicit user Task/Approved revision-wide Skip creates whole-scope WAIVED not PASS, unrelated tests/Review/Subtask gates intact. NEW LOCKED 2026-10-09: a WAIVED Required Case receiving new valid Screenshot IN SAME approved revision AUTO STARTS comparison with independent AWAITING USER REVIEW, but the effective Case QA stays WAIVED for Done gate while user reviews; no automatic waiver reset or new Done blocker. Agent CLI or user UI may explicitly CONFIRM NEW PASS or FAIL to SUPERSEDE Case WAIVED (FAIL blocks normal Done, FAIL Bug under FWL-0019), or explicitly CANCEL WAIVED to PENDING which also blocks until PASS/WAIVED again. Screenshot arrival/comparison error/NEEDS EVIDENCE itself never changes waiver or Task lane. Old revision WAIVED never valid on new revision. Confirmed Visual QA FAIL before Done creates embedded visual_qa Bug without lane movement; Review Rejected creates review-origin Bug and moves Ready for Review -> In Progress. Unresolved embedded Bug soft Done warning cannot waive Visual QA or Smart Review/tests/child gate; after Done defects separate related top-level Bug Task, origin immutable.
reasoning:
User explicitly locked 2026-10-09: screenshot receipt and automatic Visual Compare do not reset effective WAIVED for an active Required Case in the SAME Approved revision. Do not confuse comparison AWAITING USER REVIEW with QA Done-gate outcome WAIVED. Explicit Agent CLI or human UI PASS/FAIL or Cancel WAIVED alone supersedes/removes waiver, with history retained. All other Board gates and deliberate Bug status transitions and unchanged gates preserved.
User finalized 2026-10-09 Done terminal rule: NO manual Reopen or automatic transition from Done. New defects must become distinct related top-level Bug Task with independent Workflow, Review, Visual QA, and history, not a Subtask that changes original Done gate. Preserve complete original Task completion and QA/Review history.
acceptanceCriteria:
- Preserve exactly five Board lanes, Card Checklist/Subtasks, Smart Review/tests and unfinished child explicit Force Done reason; independent Done gates.
- For current Approved Preview revision, EACH ACTIVE Required Case needs its own current explicit Agent CLI or human UI PASS or individually explicit current-revision CASE WAIVED; Optional nonblocking. Whole Task/revision Skip remains separate audited WAIVED, not PASS. All historical prior-revision PASS/WAIVED not inherited.
- NEW: when a WAIVED Required Case receives new Screenshot IN SAME Approved revision, auto Visual Compare starts but effective QA remains WAIVED and current Done gate remains satisfied while image awaits human review or needs evidence; no automatic reset, FAIL/PASS or lane change.
- NEW: only explicit user new PASS/FAIL replaces the WAIVED status; new FAIL blocks normal Done and creates visual_qa Bug under prior confirmed-FAIL rule; only explicit Cancel WAIVED moves Case to PENDING and blocks normal Done. Preserve waiver/review/evidence audit and other cases.
- New Case generation/sync only from approved explicit tuples; new Required, added Required, removed Archived, reintroduced Archived RESTORE original ID/classification/history and need fresh revision QA. No fake auto PASS for empty cases.
- Pending embedded Bug soft Continue to Done not sufficient to bypass Required QA blocker or independent Review/tests/child gates. Review Rejected moves lane, Visual QA FAIL does not; Post-Done Bug separate linked Task.
- DONE IS TERMINAL (FWL-0014, USER APPROVED 2026-10-09): once Task reaches Done, do NOT show user Reopen, do NOT permit Board drag/status update/API transition out of Done, and NEVER reopen due to a Bug, QA result, Screenshot or Review. Preserve original completion timestamp, Review/QA PASS/FAIL/WAIVED and history. Newly found post-Done defect creates separate top-level Linked Bug Task starting Backlog, with its OWN 5 lanes, Smart Review/QA gates, and bidirectional origin link, not a parent/child relationship. Existing before-Done Review Rejected -> In Progress and before-Done human Visual QA FAIL embedded Bug/no move remain unchanged.
AGENT-FIRST CLI PARITY (FWL-0021..0024, user clarified 2026-10-09): every applicable work/state-changing capability in THIS card must be agent-operable through noninteractive local Flowly CLI using the SAME domain/validation/gates/audit as Web UI; agent never needs to click Flowly Web UI. CLI exposes discoverable structured context/actions/results/artifact refs, stable IDs and errors. Web UI is primarily for human monitoring and visual evidence, with existing manual fallback. USER APPROVED (2026-10-09): Agent via deliberate explicit CLI action CAN finalize Preview Approval, QA PASS/FAIL/WAIVED, Review and Done under SAME user UI validation/gates/audit; passive Screenshot receipt and auto Compare NEVER auto-approve or auto-PASS. Record actor (agent/human), CLI/UI channel, command, timestamp, evidence/revision and before/after state.
verification:
Board scenario: Approved Rev1 active A Required PASS, B Required WAIVED, C Optional FAIL. User adds new screenshot to B -> comparator AWAITING USER REVIEW but effective B remains WAIVED; Done QA gate remains satisfied (pending Bug warning separate). Bad image/NEEDS EVIDENCE or repeat screenshot doesn't auto-reset. User confirms B FAIL -> B effective FAIL reblocks Done and creates Bug on not-Done Task with unchanged lane; later user confirms PASS -> B PASS, no auto Bug Verify. New screenshot while B rewaived, then Cancel WAIVED -> B PENDING, Done blocked. Rev2 approval invalidates Rev1 WAIVED as current; case restore/history preserved but fresh PASS/WAIVED needed. Other Required/Optional cases, reviews, tests, children and Bug warnings unaffected.
Test Done Task A with prior QA and Review: attempt user reopen, Board drag or status mutation from Done to any earlier lane -> rejected without lane/history changes. New Screenshot arrives -> Compare Awaiting User Review, no Bug. User confirms new post-Done QA FAIL -> new standalone Bug Task B Backlog, independent gates and two-way links; A stays Done with historical QA/Review unchanged. Repeat same failed result -> no duplicate B. Existing before-Done Review Rejected and Visual QA FAIL lane rules unaffected.

title: Design HTML/CSS/JS UI Preview fidelity and interactive flows
description: FLOWLY V1 UI PREVIEW: local single-user Web app manages target Web/Desktop/Mobile UI. Interactive HTML/CSS/JS split source editor/live sandbox, multiple screens/named UI states/explicit viewport-window-device tuples; preserve immutable Approved revision and original project UI design-context snapshot. Draft Save despite defects, confirmed critical rendered errors block Approval, minor warnings require explicit Agent CLI or user UI nonblank reason. On successful APPROVAL generate/sync QA Cases ONLY for complete explicitly specified Screen ID+State ID+Viewport/window/device tuples, no inferred combinations. New logical Case REQUIRED default, user can edit OPTIONAL. Across different Approved revisions match by exact stable tuple, retain logical Case ID, Required/Optional, full Screenshot/Diff/QA/Bug history, but need new revision-specific QA run; added tuples new Required, removed Archived not deleted, exact returning Archived tuple RESTORED as same Case with classification/history intact and fresh pending QA. Reapproval same revision idempotent, no generation on Draft Save/Preview open, missing explicit tuples => case definition gap never QA PASS. Actual screenshot evidence from Manual Upload, Web-only Browser Capture or optional external Computer Use Local API/Relay auto-starts matched Side-by-side/Overlay/Diff and waits USER PASS/FAIL. NEW USER-APPROVED 2026-10-09: user may explicitly SKIP a single ACTIVE REQUIRED Case on current Approved revision, after confirmation persist CASE WAIVED NOT PASS with case/revision/time/action and optional note; prior evidence and Bugs intact, other Required Cases unwaived. For normal Done each current Required Case needs current explicit Agent CLI or user UI confirmed PASS or its own explicit current CASE WAIVED; Optional doesn't hard block. Previously approved separate full Task/Approved revision Skip Visual QA remains audited WAIVED; no old PASS/WAIVED carries to newer revisions. Case Skip doesn't auto-move Task, Verify Bug or bypass Review/tests/child/Bug soft warning. No mandatory built-in Agent/AI/MCP/cloud.
reasoning: UI Preview revision approval is source for immutable QA Case tuple/revision and per-revision visual validation. USER APPROVED 2026-10-09: when a current Approved revision ACTIVE Required Case is already explicitly WAIVED and a NEW actual screenshot is captured/uploaded/received, Flowly still AUTO STARTS Side-by-side/Overlay/Diff comparison to that same Approved revision but KEEPS effective Case QA WAIVED while comparison is AWAITING USER REVIEW (or NEEDS EVIDENCE). Screenshot alone never cancels waiver, marks PASS/FAIL or changes Task/bug. User's explicit new PASS/FAIL replaces WAIVED with audited current-revision verdict, or explicit Cancel WAIVED reopens case PENDING for the current revision. Same-revision waiver preserved across comparison; on a DIFFERENT Approved revision old WAIVED is historical only, as old PASS is. Active Required Done gate each needs current explicit Agent CLI or user UI confirmed PASS or current explicit WAIVED; Optional nonblocking. Preserves the approved cross-revision sync and Archived-case restore semantics and separate Task/revision waiver.
acceptanceCriteria:
- Preserve immutable interactive HTML/CSS/JS Preview with Approval gate (critical render defects block; minor warnings need user's nonblank acceptance, Draft Save allowed).
- Approved Preview produces QA Cases ONLY for explicit Screen+State+Viewport/window/device tuples, no Cartesian product, all NEW Cases Required editable Optional; cross-revision exact active cases retain ID/classification/evidence but need new QA, removed Archived, reintroduced Archived restored original ID with history and fresh QA.
- Reapproval same revision idempotent; no cases on Preview open/Draft Save; empty defined tuples => definition gap, never automatic QA PASS.
- NEW: a single user can explicitly confirm Skip for ONE active Required Case at current approved revision -> CASE WAIVED not PASS, save case/revision/time and optional note; preserve original screenshots/QA/Bug history and other Cases, not reclassify Required.
- Normal Done visual QA requires current explicit Agent CLI or user UI PASS OR independently confirmed current CASE WAIVED for ALL active Required Cases; Optional nonblocking. Existing separate whole Task/revision Skip Visual QA remains audited WAIVED not PASS; no old revision PASS/WAIVED reuse.
- Valid actual screenshot auto-starts case Compare, only explicit Agent CLI or user UI confirmation sets PASS/FAIL. Neither Case Skip nor full Task Skip bypasses unrelated Smart Review/tests/child or pending Bug soft warnings; no automatic Task/Bug transition.
AGENT-FIRST CLI PARITY (FWL-0021..0024, user clarified 2026-10-09): every applicable work/state-changing capability in THIS card must be agent-operable through noninteractive local Flowly CLI using the SAME domain/validation/gates/audit as Web UI; agent never needs to click Flowly Web UI. CLI exposes discoverable structured context/actions/results/artifact refs, stable IDs and errors. Web UI is primarily for human monitoring and visual evidence, with existing manual fallback. USER APPROVED (2026-10-09): Agent via deliberate explicit CLI action CAN finalize Preview Approval, QA PASS/FAIL/WAIVED, Review and Done under SAME user UI validation/gates/audit; passive Screenshot receipt and auto Compare NEVER auto-approve or auto-PASS. Record actor (agent/human), CLI/UI channel, command, timestamp, evidence/revision and before/after state.
verification: Approved Rev1 Screen/State/Viewport Required Case B explicitly WAIVED; upload Web/Desktop/Mobile screenshot for same case/revision -> automatic Side-by-side/Overlay/Diff preparation, effective B remains WAIVED, old waiver and new capture history shown separately. Even failed compare/NEEDS EVIDENCE doesn't revoke. Explicit new explicit Agent CLI or user UI PASS or FAIL replaces B WAIVED with auditable verdict; explicit Cancel WAIVED makes B pending and required gate blocker. Rev2 approval still needs fresh PASS/WAIVED; no waiver inheritance. Other active Cases or Task/Bug lanes unchanged. Previous draft/approval QA gates remain independent.

title: Design risk-based Review policy with manual override
description: DESIGN APPROVED BY USER (2026-10-09): Flowly V1 Smart Review uses explainable deterministic structured task metadata, not LLM or keyword-based natural-language judgments. HIGH: any security/permissions impact, destructive data change, schema migration, public API/contract change, shared runtime config, system-wide scope or irreversible work. LOW: local scope AND reversible AND documented expected outcome AND acceptance criteria AND verification step AND no high-risk flags. MEDIUM: all remaining cases, including unknown/missing data/shared scope. Precedence HIGH > LOW > MEDIUM; no arbitrary score. Auto skips Review only at LOW; MEDIUM/HIGH require Review by default. Manual Require Review always possible. Manual Skip Review allowed at any risk, but when Auto requires Review a nonblank reason is mandatory. Show the classification factors, persist decision/rationale/reason/state history, reassess at change/transition, enforce server-side. Bypassing Review never bypasses verification. No AI/Agent/MCP/Cloud. This card tracks approved requirements, NOT completed implementation.
reasoning: APPROVAL: user explicitly agreed to the risk criteria and decision table on 2026-10-09. These are now product requirements, no longer a proposal. Still in Backlog because Flowly implementation has not begun. Keep classification a pure typed domain policy and event history; expose clear UI reason. Source-of-truth contract belongs to FWL-0004 and FWL-0002 consumes it.
acceptanceCriteria:
1. Auto LOW only with local scope + reversible=yes + expected outcome + acceptance criteria + verification step + zero high-risk flags; otherwise never silently classify LOW.
2. HIGH for system-wide change, irreversible change, or any of security/permissions, destructive data, schema migration, public API/contract, shared runtime config risk flags.
3. MEDIUM for remaining non-high cases, including missing/unknown impact, shared scope, or missing outcome/verification details; default to Review.
4. Auto selects In Progress -> Done bypass only when LOW; MEDIUM/HIGH go to Ready for Review by default.
5. Manual Require Review is always permitted; manual Skip Review is permitted for ALL risk levels, but requires a nonblank reason when Auto would require Review (MEDIUM/HIGH).
6. Empty/whitespace reason or invalid transition is rejected by backend, not just UI; show understandable feedback.
7. Card UI shows LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH, Auto decision and the exact factors/rules that led to it.
8. On card edits and before transition, refresh assessment; append review mode, risk, rationale, override reason, timestamp, and previous/next status to durable history.

- Agent-created CLI state/events appear in UI from SAME authoritative domain/SQLite without manual refresh requiring agent to stop; after reopening tab/restarting app, state and history reconcile. Display changed-by/channel metadata where recorded, without inventing multiuser login/RBAC.
- Human Web UI mainly monitors and can explicitly approve/intervene, while Agent CLI may ALSO explicitly finalize Preview, QA PASS/FAIL/WAIVED, Review and Done with the same gates. UI shows actor/channel and any pending or completed CLI decision; no required human click for routine agent approvals. Do not require UI clicks for ordinary agent operations; preserve approved Manual Screenshot Upload, interactive Preview viewing/editing fallback and single-user workflow semantics where already locked.
- UI clearly distinguishes awaiting human decision, blocked gate, in-progress CLI job, successful completion, failed/needs-evidence, and historical Done/Deleted events. The old Done Task cannot be manually Reopened; post-Done defect appears as linked independent Bug Task.
- Keep active Screenshot lists separate from History Deleted filter, protect QA/Bug evidence on Cleanup and avoid leaking Local API token or browser session credentials in activity feeds. Workflows remain operational while monitor UI is closed; no Agent/Relay/LLM required in app.
- Monitoring-first UI shows explicit Agent CLI Preview Approval, QA PASS/FAIL/WAIVED, Review and Done actions with actor/channel/time/evidence and current blockers; the human user may also deliberately perform these same actions in Web UI. Do NOT place a mandatory human confirmation between agent CLI command and a valid gated approval. Passive screenshot, auto compare or background agent progress must never appear as confirmed PASS. Expose failed CLI validation clearly and preserve audit/history.
verification:
Monitor UI E2E: agent runs Flowly CLI with no browser tab open; later browser UI shows exact Board, progress, QA Review gates, command jobs, actionable errors, Preview, Bug links and evidence. Refresh and restart preserve state. Check manual intervention controls, empty/failed/long-running jobs, recent updates, audit fields, no sensitive data in UI, Deleted History and protected QA evidence. Web UI closing must never block or stop CLI work.
Agent CLI performs explicit gated Preview Approve, QA PASS/FAIL/WAIVED, Review, Done while browser monitor closed; opening UI reflects same outcomes/evidence, actor/channel and history. Blocked CLI action surfaces actionable error without dishonest UI success; passive image/compare never show PASS. Human user can explicitly override or intervene with same validation.
